blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The bill that fixes the term of barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) officials to five years has already been transmitted to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian gave the information on Thursday. The measure – Senate Bill No. 2397 – effectively postpones the upcoming polls in November. The House of Representatives also adopted the bill. The legislative piece also moves the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections, for a second time, from the first Monday of November 2026 to the second Monday of November 2028.
